passages.quote:
UK Visas and Immigration guidance for staff on handling change of circumstance requests relating to Worker and Temporary Worker sponsors.

This includes information on:

processing a change request case

checking and requesting submission sheets and supporting evidence

requesting further evidence and information from a sponsor

what to do if a sponsor is non-cooperative

using Metastorm

checking license status and routes and reviewing license history
